tasks.title: Status installs the merged contract patch after #809 and passes all checks
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, R7, all Precondition checks and Completion evidence; Rollout order step 2; Security impact and Acceptance evidence 5.

acceptance.expected: Before any edit, state is CLOSED. If OPEN, request a needs-input hold naming #809; do not race the in-flight pin work. Preserve the fan-out requirement that a person links this child as blocked by #809.
Read main's actual contract pin before any edit; use it as PIN in the following compare commands, and use the merged contract child's patch commit as PATCH_SHA.

Before any edit, first status is ahead or identical and second is ahead. Otherwise request needs-input for an older/incompatible pin, or a hold if the patch is already present (second identical or behind).

Both files pin the same full 40-character SHA of the merged pulse-contract main commit containing R1-R6, independently identified from the contract child's merged PR; preserve intervening merged features.
exit 0; frozen install, lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with the repository's existing coverage threshold; no tooling, coverage or budget gate is weakened.

acceptance.command: bunx playwright install chromium && bun run check:a11y
acceptance.expected: exit 0; Chromium accessibility suite passes (package.json:18; ci.yml:51,66,68).

acceptance.command: git diff origin/main --name-only && git diff --check && gh pr view --json body,statusCheckRollup
acceptance.expected: Only package.json and bun.lock differ; whitespace check passes and CI check/a11y pass. PR records #809 and compare preconditions, full merged patch SHA, required-check evidence and applicable security checklist (full SHA, matching frozen lockfile). No new tests or source changes; no performance change or measurement required because main already pins 2.5.0. This task belongs to Rollout step 2; status reads no stored notify channels and creates no api reader-order precondition.
